verdict.rationale: GitHub README explicitly points to an official upgrade guide for moving existing projects to newer versions, indicating first-party support for this workflow. However, the evidence pack lacks detailed content from the guide itself (e.g., version-specific steps, automated migration schematics) and independent developer accounts confirming smooth upgrade experiences; historical community comments even note a major backwards-compatibility break (Angular 1→2). Missing for 10: detailed upgrade guide content/steps, evidence of ng update tooling, and independent hands-on confirmation of successful upgrades across versions.
